task.title: Synchronize verified terminal workflow and task completion
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/781 with an opt-in atomic boundary that advances a verified task attributed workflow to authored terminal and completes its active task.
acceptance_criteria: Require one exact authored gated transition whose target phase is terminal and one active attributed task.
Evaluate exact identified Verification for the supplied Attempt and preserve complete pending or failed reports.
Append the existing workflow advancement and exact-output task completion events atomically with both revisions guarded.
Reject evidence, task terminal, and workflow races without exposing a partial lifecycle state.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-run test failed because advance_and_complete_task_if_verification_passes did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added success and replay, pending, failed, lineage, non-terminal-target, task evidence, task terminal, and workflow-race tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Calling independent verified advancement and completion operations sequentially could expose either lifecycle transition without the other.
attempts.patch: Reused existing events and the event log's exact-version pair append, added typed terminal-target and task state validation, and recorded ADR-0033.

attempts.summary: Completed independent and substantive review follow-ups.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found missing historical follow-on notes and exact replayed-output coverage; substantive review identified duplicated verified-advance preflight and an undocumented crate-private completion precondition.
attempts.patch: Added the documentation notes, replay assertion, terminal-race coverage, and helper precondition documentation; preserved the larger duplication finding as bounded follow-up issue 783 rather than expanding the feature patch.

outcome.summary: Callers can atomically advance an exactly verified workflow to authored terminal and complete its active attributed task with exact output, while independent lifecycle APIs remain available.

lessons: Two lifecycle writes that represent one opt-in terminal decision need one atomic transaction rather than compensating sequential calls.
Reuse authoritative aggregate events instead of introducing a duplicate combined aggregate solely for coordination.
Exact replay assertions should cover terminal detail, not only status and revision.
Keep behavior-preserving duplication cleanup in a separate bounded issue when the feature patch is already correct and fully guarded.
